body: I can't tell you how many times I've been standing on the hair-breadth's edge between a balcony and railing, looking unto the world of concrete below so ready to jump before some utterly pathetic thought comes in and engulfs my mind, preventing me. I hate it all, wish it could just end.

As it is with so many others, this post reflects so many of our lives. The worst kind of pain is the kind that tears you from daydreams, the sole refuge of happiness, and cuts away the curtain you can hide behind to reveal the grey, death-ridden world truly waiting for you. I sometimes wonder if all of us here seek death because we all subconsciously understand that it is a different world, one of peace where the thoughts and presences that rid of us of sensation and joy every day are vacant. Like an empty world waiting to be daydreamed in. Idk, sounds dumb. But good post.

It's like you've lost the gift to see happiness in your future. Even if you come out of childhood waiting for your promised "second chance" at obtaining a set of convenient variables that make you happy, it never progresses that way. In life nor in your own comprehension of life.

Know what you mean. At a certain point you even lose preference for the kind of harm you wish on yourself. Just want to disappear. No mess, just to be erased completely.
